Fiscal Receipt Capture (bločky / účtenky)

Captures cash-register receipts from a QR code, a photograph or an expense upload, checks that their figures add up, and turns them into a draft vendor receipt or an employee expense with the VAT split by rate.

Version19.0.1.1.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresaccount, mail, l10n_cssk_core
Extended byl10n_cssk_receipt_capture_ai (delivered separately), l10n_cssk_receipt_capture_expense, l10n_sk_ekasa_receipt

What it is for

Fuel, meals, small purchases: a business collects many till receipts (bločky in Slovakia, účtenky in Czechia), and each has to be booked with its VAT split by rate. This module is the common frame for that. It holds the captured receipt — seller, date, total, items and the per-rate VAT recap — and turns it into Odoo documents, while separate capture providers supply the data:

Provider Module Reads
eKasa lookup l10n_sk_ekasa_receipt the QR code of a Slovak receipt; the seller's registered receipt, items and all, is fetched from the Finančná správa service
AI reader l10n_cssk_receipt_capture_ai (delivered separately) the photograph, with a language model — for Czech and foreign receipts, and Slovak ones whose code cannot be read (see AI reader)

A receipt that reads cleanly becomes a draft vendor receipt (Odoo's Purchase Receipt) or, with l10n_cssk_receipt_capture_expense, an employee expense (see Expenses). A receipt whose figures do not add up is parked for review, never rounded into place.

The VAT recap is kept as its own table because it is the only trustworthy source and a receipt may carry three rates (a Slovak restaurant bill: food, soft drinks, alcohol). Item quantities are kept on the receipt but posted as quantity 1 at the line total, since a unit price rounded to cents would not foot (31.17 l of fuel for 57.85 € is not 1.86 € × 31.17).

Legal background

  • When a receipt is enough to deduct VAT. A till receipt is a simplified tax document only up to a limit; above it the buyer needs a full invoice.
  • Slovakia: a document issued by a pokladnica e-kasa klient is a simplified invoice "ak cena tovaru alebo služby vrátane dane nie je viac ako 400 eur" — § 74 ods. 3 písm. b) of the VAT Act; the deduction requires an invoice — § 51 ods. 1 písm. a).
  • Czechia: a zjednodušený daňový doklad may be issued only "pokud celková částka za plnění na daňovém dokladu není vyšší než 10000 Kč" — § 30 odst. 1 of the VAT Act No. 235/2004 Sb..
  • The eKasa lookup. Under § 18 ods. 1 of Act No. 384/2025 Z. z. the Financial Directorate lets anyone verify, through the QR code or the receipt identifier, the data of receipts sent to the eKasa system and makes them available, repeatedly. A verifier (overovateľ, § 2 ods. 1 písm. aj)) must first notify the Financial Directorate of the IP address it calls from and must send truthful verification results — § 18 ods. 11. The eKasa module refuses lookups until that notification is confirmed in its settings.

What is sent, when, and by whom

Where What Provider
Finančná správa (eKasa) the QR code text, or identifiers printed on the receipt eKasa lookup
your model provider, or Data Dance's extraction service through the broker the photograph or PDF of the receipt AI reader
the public company registers the seller's IČO, to confirm its name AI reader

A reading starts when:

  • someone with Invoicing rights presses Capture on a receipt (New, Error or Needs Review);
  • any employee scans a QR code with Scan Receipt (the camera is read in the browser; only the decoded text reaches the server);
  • any employee uploads receipt images in the Expenses app while Capture on Expense Upload is on (the default) — one reading per image, run with superuser rights so that employees need no access to accounting;
  • a reading failed for a temporary reason (service busy or unreachable): it is retried automatically after 15 minutes, 1 hour and 4 hours. A refusal, an unknown receipt or an unreadable photograph is never retried on a timer.

Providers are tried in their order, code readers first: with the eKasa lookup enabled, a Slovak receipt with a readable QR code never reaches the model. Every attempt is logged on the receipt (Attempts) with its outcome, duration and, for the AI reader, tokens and cost.

Setting it up

Accounting → Configuration → Settings, block Fiscal Receipt Capture (labels in English; the module has no Czech or Slovak catalogue yet):

Setting Purpose
Receipt Journal purchase journal for vendor receipts; empty uses the first one
Default Expense Account account of every line; required before a vendor receipt can be created
Document Detail One line per VAT rate (default — posts exactly the base the seller reported) or One line per receipt item
Auto-create Seller currently has no effect: sellers are created with the Create Seller button
Receipts: AI Model Chain with the AI reader, see below

The purchase tax for each VAT rate is taken from the VAT-rate mapping of account_invoice_ai_extract (delivered separately) when installed, else the company's default purchase tax or a domestic purchase tax of that rate. A mapping that points a rate at a tax of another rate is refused.

Accounting → Configuration → Accounting → Capture Providers (managers) lists the providers with their order, countries and an Active switch.

To read QR codes off photographs, the server needs the Python package zxing-cpp; without it the receipt says so and the camera scan still works.

Working with receipts

Accounting → Vendors → Fiscal Receipts:

  • Scan Receipt — opens the camera; scan the fiscal QR code. A loyalty or web link printed next to it is rejected and the scanner stays open.
  • Captured Receipts — all receipts. New, attach the photograph (Source image) or paste the QR text (QR payload), then Capture.
  • To Review — receipts that are new, failed or parked.

States: New → Captured (everything adds up), Needs Review (a check failed; the reason is shown), Error (the source refused or nothing could read it; the reason is shown) → Posted once a document exists.

Checks before a receipt counts as captured:

  • a total exists, and base plus VAT equals it;
  • the items sum to the total;
  • every VAT bucket is arithmetically right for its rate, and matches the items carrying that rate; no item carries a rate missing from the recap;
  • no item is marked as a return or correction (their sign is never guessed);
  • for an AI reading, the model's confidence is above zero and not below the company's threshold.

A receipt already captured with the same receipt identifier is refused as a duplicate. Accept Anyway moves a parked receipt to Captured on your responsibility; the reported discrepancy is kept in the chatter.

The seller is matched by VAT number, then IČO, then tax number — never by name. Create Seller creates a partner from the receipt's name, VAT number and IČO. The premises where the receipt was issued are kept as a note and do not reach the partner.

VAT that may not be deducted. When the total exceeds the limit above (400 EUR for a seller with a Slovak VAT number, 10 000 Kč for a Czech one; by the company's country when the receipt shows no VAT number), the receipt says so and its VAT is booked as part of the cost. Tick Full invoice held when you have a full invoice for the purchase. A vendor receipt from such a receipt cannot be posted with VAT on it.

Create Vendor Receipt creates a draft Purchase Receipt dated with the receipt, referenced by the receipt identifier, with one line per VAT rate or per item (quantity 1, net amount, the default expense account), and a copy of the photograph. It is refused when a rate has no purchase tax, when the mapped tax is price-included, or when the document's total or VAT — in total or per rate — differs from the receipt. Review and post it as usual.

AI reader

l10n_cssk_receipt_capture_ai (delivered separately) reads a photographed or scanned receipt (an image, or a PDF) with a language model, through the same connection as AI invoice extraction (delivered separately). It is the only reader for Czech receipts, which carry no code that can be looked up.

  • What is sent: the image — re-encoded as PNG if it is BMP or TIFF — or the PDF, with fixed instructions for receipts. The model returns the seller's identifiers, date, total, items with line totals including VAT, the VAT recap, its confidence and notes, and the fiscal identifiers printed on a Slovak receipt.
  • Printed identifiers: when a Slovak QR code could not be decoded, those identifiers are tried with the eKasa lookup; if the registered receipt is found (and its total matches the photograph), its figures replace the reading, otherwise the receipt is parked for review.
  • Seller name from the register: by the IČO read, through l10n_cssk_registry_verify, when the register's VAT number agrees with the one read — or, with no VAT number to compare, when the names do not contradict each other. Otherwise the reading stands and the chatter says why.
  • Model chain: Receipts: AI Model Chain in the receipt settings — the same mechanism as for invoices, usually with a stronger model, since thermal paper reads worse than a PDF. Empty uses the default provider and model of AI invoice extraction, whose confidence threshold also applies.
  • The AI Reading tab shows the confidence, the model's notes, tokens and cost (cost hidden through the broker).

Every reading is a paid call; see what is sent for who can start one.

Expenses

l10n_cssk_receipt_capture_expense connects receipts with Odoo's Expenses app (Community):

  • Create Expenses on a captured receipt (Invoicing users) creates one expense for the whole receipt, whatever its VAT rates, for the employee of the current user, in the category set under Expenses → Configuration → Settings → Receipt Capture (Receipt Expense Category; empty uses Odoo's general expense category). Its total and VAT are checked against the receipt.
  • Uploading receipts in Expenses (Expenses → My Expenses, Odoo's Upload button) — with Capture on Expense Upload on, each image becomes a receipt and is read; a clean reading fills the expense (amount, taxes, vendor), otherwise the expense shows why. A notification sums up how many were read, need checking or failed.
  • Scan Receipt and My Receipts appear under Expenses → My Expenses; an employee sees the receipts they captured and those behind their own expenses.
  • Several VAT rates on one expense. Odoo applies all of an expense's taxes to one base, which for 23 % and 5 % would give 28 % on everything. For an expense from a receipt, the VAT figure and the journal entry — employee-paid or company-paid — are built rate by rate from the receipt's recap. Such an expense refuses to post once its amount or taxes are edited away from the receipt.
  • When the receipt's VAT is not deductible, the expense carries the gross amount without tax.
  • A receipt claimed as expenses can no longer become a vendor receipt, and vice versa.

Limitations

  • The deduction limit is applied by the seller's VAT prefix to every receipt: the Slovak 400 EUR rule is written for e-kasa receipts, and the general 100 EUR rule of § 74 ods. 3 písm. a) is not applied. For Czech receipts the module assumes that a receipt up to 10 000 Kč is a valid simplified tax document; it does not check its contents.
  • Auto-create Seller in the settings does nothing.
  • Returns and corrections on a receipt are not posted automatically.
  • Item quantities are informative only; every line is quantity 1.
  • All lines go to the default expense account; recode fuel, meals and the rest afterwards.
  • Expense uploads by employees start paid AI readings without an accountant in the loop; switch Capture on Expense Upload off if that is not wanted.
  • The AI reader's figures are a reading of paper: the checks catch figures that do not add up, not a total misread consistently everywhere.
